description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages voice recognition for wake word detection and command handling in an Android application. It uses Android's SpeechRecognizer API, Kotlin coroutines, and flows to handle asynchronous recognition states and events.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection and command execution using Android's SpeechRecognizer, supporting coroutine-based asynchronous handling and state flows.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words for wake detection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts voice recognition and listening process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops voice recognition and listening process.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognizer listening.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the listening process after a delay.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Handles recognized speech, extracts commands, and triggers callback if command is new.
